description: This Java class 'ImportProductHelper' provides utility methods for preparing product and inventory item data maps and checking product existence in the database within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ImportProductHelper
classes.description: Final utility class for preparing product and inventory data and checking product existence.

methods.name: prepareProduct
methods.description: Creates a map of product attributes with given productId, setting default values for productTypeId, internalName, isVirtual, and isVariant.

methods.name: prepareInventoryItem
methods.description: Creates a map of inventory item attributes with specified productId, quantityOnHand, and inventoryItemId.

methods.name: checkProductExists
methods.description: Checks if a product with the given productId exists in the database using the Delegator, returns true if exists.
